responsibility: Builds and validates Typed High-level IR (THIR) for a body as the bridge from typed HIR to later MIR construction and pattern analysis. This module organizes the THIR namespace, drives body lowering through the THIR context entry point, lowers expressions and blocks/statements with scope, adjustment, unsafe, and user-type information preserved, converts literals into `ty::Const` values, and provides shared helpers for recovering user-written type annotations. It also contains the THIR pattern pipeline: lowering HIR patterns and constant patterns into THIR form, deconstructing patterns into the constructor-based representation used for analysis, running the usefulness algorithm for exhaustiveness and reachability, and performing match and irrefutability checking with diagnostics.
